claims.claim_text: Markforged operates an in-house manufacturing facility in greater Boston, Massachusetts where it produces consumables (composite/metal materials).
claims.subject: Markforged
claims.source_quote: Markforged is based in greater Boston, Massachusetts, where we have our own in-house manufacturing facility and our headquarters

claims.claim_text: Markforged has a design and manufacturing facility in Hoganas, Sweden (acquired via Digital Metal AB) for metal binder jetting.
claims.subject: Markforged / Digital Metal AB
claims.source_quote: We also have a design and manufacturing facility located in Hoganas, Sweden

claims.claim_text: Markforged invented and patented the Continuous Fiber Reinforcement (CFR) additive manufacturing process and asserts a proprietary IP portfolio in composite/metal 3D printing.
claims.subject: Markforged
claims.object_value: continuous fiber composite + metal binder jetting 3D printing
claims.source_quote: Our patented Continuous Fiber Reinforcement ( CFR ) process uses continuous strands of composite fibers ... We invented and patented the CFR composite additive manufacturing process.

claims.claim_text: Markforged has 'blue chip customers' in aerospace, military and defense, automotive, healthcare, space exploration, and food and beverage industries.
claims.subject: Markforged
claims.source_quote: Blue chip customers in industries such as food and beverage, aerospace, military and defense, industrial automation, space exploration, healthcare and automotive rely on our platform
